acceptance.description: Batch trends endpoint validates/deduplicates at most 20 US symbols and returns one explicit row per input symbol.
evidence: The batch endpoint uppercases and deduplicates valid US codes, rejects invalid codes before history requests, enforces a 20-code query bound, and returns one result for each normalized code. Covered by the focused mocked API suite.

acceptance.description: SMA-5/SMA-20 trend status is computed from validated Moomoo daily bars with null/unavailable behavior for insufficient or failed history.
evidence: SMA-5/SMA-20 uses validated positive finite daily closes, excludes the requested current UTC-date bar, reports insufficient history or per-symbol failures as unavailable with null metrics, and covers bullish/bearish/neutral outcomes in mocked tests.

acceptance.description: Response exposes method, QFQ basis, latest bar date and retrieval timestamp, and labels the indicator as descriptive rather than a forecast/recommendation.
evidence: Per-symbol and request responses include method, QFQ basis, latest included bar date, retrieval timestamps, and explicit descriptive-only/non-forecast wording. Assertions passed in tests/test_moomoo_api.py.
